The '''Circle of Jedi Healers''' was an organization of [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] that functioned within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] since before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]]. Based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] deep within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Halls of Healing]], the Circle was made up of some of the Order's best healers. Reporting directly to the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]], the Circle filled many roles, including the protection of the [[Healing Crystals of Fire]] and the organization of the [[Medical Corps/Legends|Medical Corps]].<ref name="TJP" />

Membership within the Circle was not restricted to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] as many times [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] were inducted into their ranks. Following her completion of the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], Knight [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was selected to join the Circle.<ref name="BO">{{DB|character|barrissoffee|Offee, Barriss}}</ref> [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member Master [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] was also a member.<ref name="SA">{{DB|character|stassallie|Allie, Stass}}</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] saw to it that the members of the Circle, as well as the rest of the Order, were killed during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] through the efforts of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Several decades after the Circle was disbanded, the [[New Jedi Order|reformed]] Jedi Order did not reconstitute the Circle. While [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] knew of students that would have made great members of the organizational body, such as Master [[Cilghal]], he did not see a reason to reinstate the tradition.<ref name="TJP" />
